summary: Your twenty-third Sunday review and the end of the model-serving week. You answer 9 questions on open-weight models, memory, quantization, servers and the comparison with a confidence number, write the module retrospective (including how small your comparison was), extend your glossary, tag week 23 and plan week 24 (README, demo and pitch).

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Write the retrospective of the model-serving week, 2 lines for each of 5 questions
Write exactly what you ran this week and what you could not run
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Error log: group this week's entries into 3 themes and fix the top one
Run git tag week-23, then plan week 24 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 3 to 5 applications
Play the Model Serving Mix-up game to the end and see your score
